key_difference: (B) fixes run() locally with a destructor on RunFunctionTaskBase that cancels and finishes an unfinished promise when the pool deletes the discarded task; (D) instead adds a new exported discard-handler registry to QThreadPoolPrivate, called from every QFutureInterfaceBase::setRunnable/reportFinished and from ThreadEngine. That adds cross-module API surface, extra pool-mutex traffic on the hot path, and possible stale or dangling handler entries keyed by raw runnable pointers, plus it extends into the map/filter path that (B) deliberately left out of scope.
